gloss: to keep in mind; to bear in mind

definitions.gloss: to keep in mind; to bear in mind; to be mindful of
definitions.explanation: To consciously maintain awareness of something when making decisions or taking action. A somewhat formal expression used in both spoken and written Japanese.

examples.japanese: ⟦リスク→リスク：06752_risuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{念頭|ねんとう}に{置|お}く。
examples.english: To keep the risks in mind.

examples.japanese: ⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{念頭|ねんとう}→念頭：12572_nentou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{置|お}いて→置く：01092_oku⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please act with safety in mind.

examples.japanese: ⟦{将来|しょうらい}→将来：01438_shourai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{念頭|ねんとう}→念頭：12572_nentou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{置|お}いた→置く：01092_oku⟧⟦{投資|とうし}→投資：04711_toushi⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: It's important to create an investment plan that keeps future growth in mind.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
～⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{念頭|ねんとう}に{置|お}く (to keep ~ in mind)
～⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{念頭|ねんとう}→念頭：12572_nentou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{置|お}いて→置く：01092_oku⟧ (keeping ~ in mind — te-form used adverbially)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{念頭|ねんとう}に{置|お}く (to keep safety in mind)
- ⟦リスク→リスク：06752_risuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{念頭|ねんとう}に{置|お}く (to keep risks in mind)
- ⟦{念頭|ねんとう}→念頭：12572_nentou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{置|お}いた→置く：01092_oku⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (with ~ in mind)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧おく: To make a mental note — more casual and colloquial.
- ⟦{心|こころ}がける→心がける：10015_kokorogakeru⟧: To try to, to be mindful of — implies active effort to maintain a habit or principle.
- ⟦{意識|いしき}する→意識する：17974_ishikisuru⟧: To be conscious of — broader, can mean simply being aware without the deliberate planning nuance of {念頭|ねんとう}に{置|お}く.
